# MBORMC | insectscreen.cc
> MBORMC DIY insect screen vertical website, Foshan direct factory supplying custom made-to-measure mosquito & fly screens for global homeowners, rental apartments, small villas in UK, USA, Australia, Japan and Europe. All products support tool-free DIY installation within 10 minutes, adopt premium 6063-T5 aluminum frame, PET, fiberglass and scratch-resistant 304 stainless steel mesh. Accept single private orders & small bulk projects, offer sample service, OEM private label customization with factory direct price 40%-60% cheaper than local stores. Global sea, air & express shipping, 2-year warranty for all core mechanisms.
